result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a missing icon inside the top-right header action button.

issues.description: The circular button in the top-right corner of the header shows a red notification badge dot, but the icon itself (e.g., notification bell or cart icon) is missing, leaving an empty gray circle.
issues.suggestion: Render the appropriate icon SVG/asset inside the circular button container and ensure its color contrasts properly against the light gray background.
